newsitem.title: USA: Pa. says February revenues 7.8 pct above forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Pa. says February revenues 7.8 pct above forecasts.

text.p: Pennsylvania's general fund collections of $1.1 billion in February were $80.1 million, or 7.8 percent, above official projections, the state's Department of Revenue said.
Year-to-date collections of $9.9 billion were $269.2 million, or 2.8 percent, over projections.

The state said collections so far this year have been above projections for every major tax category, including 0.8 percent for corporation taxes, three percent for consumption taxes, and 3.2 percent for the other taxes.
Total corporation tax collections fell below estimate for February by $9.7 million, but the year-to-date figure is still $10.5 million above estimates, the state said.
